newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Hicks, Muse plans US$400 mln Taiwan investment.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse plans US$400 mln Taiwan investment.

text.p: U.S. investment firm Hicks, Muse/Mills & Partners plans to invest US$400 million in Taiwan's manufacturing industry, the economics ministry said on Friday.

"To establish cooperation relations with Taiwan enterprises, Hicks Muse is now, through the assistance of the economics ministry, actively promoting a joint-venture plan, with itself investing US$400 million and Taiwan partners investing US$100 million in Taiwan," the ministry said in a statement.
Hicks, Muse/Mills & Partners is an affiliate of Dallas-based Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc.
Hicks, Muse plans to invest in the island's printed circuits, electrical wire and cable and connectors industry, the statement said.
Hicks, Muse already had acquired local firm Berg Electronics, which produces telecommunication connectors, it said.
In August 1993, Hicks, Muse signed an agreement with the ministry to forge a strategic alliance, agreeing to set up a regional operations centre in Taiwan, the ministry said.
